newsitem.title: USA: Ford's Jaguar in recalls over rear suspsension.
newsitem.headline: Ford's Jaguar in recalls over rear suspsension.

text.p: Jaguar said Friday it is calling 2,303 XK8s in the United States and 162 in Canada to inspect the rear suspension. The company said it expects one percent of those involved in the recall, or about 25 cars, may need to have the retaining rings in the driveshaft reseated or replaced.

The company said that if the two dozen cars in question are subject to extreme cornering maneuvers on rough pavement, the output shaft could detach from the differential unit, which would cause a rear wheel to collapse, but that the forces required to provoke the failure are so high that they would probably only be encountered during rigorous testing.
Worldwide, XK8s with Vehicle Identification Numbers between 001531 and 006306 are being recalled for inspection.
Jaguar, a unit of Ford Motor Co, said it knows of no injuries resulting from the condition. Of the three reported incidents, two were encountered during testing.
The third failure was discovered while the car was on a hoist.
